{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define the subset: CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
subset = df[(df['arm'] == 'CONTROL') & (df['severity'] == 'MODERATE')]

# Check the size of the subset
print('Number of CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity:', len(subset))

# Count how many of them responded (responded == 1)
responded_count = subset['responded'].sum()
print('Number who responded:', responded_count)

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / len(subset)
print('Fraction who responded:', fraction_responded)

# Return the fraction as a float
fraction_responded"}
